data.issue_overview: [Demo mode – template guidance, not AI] This appears to be a dispute over the refund of a rental security deposit after vacating. Whether deductions are allowed usually depends on the rental agreement and the condition of the property.
confirmed_facts: Issue type: Security deposit not refunded
assumptions: The demo engine uses templates and cannot assess the specific facts.

legal_options.description: Send a dated letter/email asking for the refund within a fixed time.
legal_options.considerations: Low cost; creates a written record.

legal_options.description: Seek a settlement through mediation or a Lok Adalat via the District Legal Services Authority.
legal_options.considerations: Free or low cost; needs both sides to cooperate.

legal_options.description: A lawyer can advise on a legal notice or civil claim under the law applicable in your state.
legal_options.considerations: Costs time and money; consider for larger amounts.

data.title: Request for Refund of Security Deposit (demo template)
data.subject: Request for refund of security deposit of ₹25,000
data.body:
Dear [Landlord's name],

I was a tenant at [property address] from [start date] to [date of vacating]. At the start of the tenancy I paid a security deposit of ₹25,000. I vacated the property on [date] and handed over the keys. Despite my requests, the deposit has not been refunded.

I request you to refund ₹25,000 (less any deduction you can justify in writing with supporting bills) within 15 days of this letter, to [bank details / UPI ID].

I have attached copies of the supporting documents.

Yours sincerely,
[Your name]
[Phone] | [Email]

items.item: Bank / UPI statements showing the transaction
WhatsApp/SMS messages with the other party
items.why_needed: Shows your requests and their replies

items.item: Any notice or letter sent or received
